about_the_game:
It's time for battle, commander!

Steel Skirmish: Reloaded is an arcade-style tank shooter played primarily in the third person. Players can fight either in the online mode against each other in teams of 10 or can battle solo against waves of enemies in the survival game mode. The game features a variety of tanks, maps, options, and features, allowing for the fun to continue for many hours of gameplay.

Combat within the game is fast-paced, requiring a player to exhibit speed and solid coordination in order to succeed. You'll have several chances to respawn, but you only have so many, so be careful! This isn't just a battle of reflexes, though - position and cover prove vital, so plan your steps accordingly.

Online PvP

Online matches are hosted on a peer-to-peer model and can be played in Standard or Supremacy modes in either a daytime or nighttime setting. There's no need to gather a crowd - bots can be added to fill in space in the lobby or to simply play a team-based match by oneself. Matches can be played on any of the game's six maps and allow for rule customizations to fine-tune the experience.

Survival

Survival matches are fought on a condensed area against endless waves of increasingly strong enemies. Several chances to respawn are provided, but that's no excuse to slack off - just one mistake can prove detrimental. Fight the hardest to face the most difficult enemies and achieve the highest score.

Vehicle Selection

Ten different vehicles are available in the game, and no two are alike. Each vehicle features unique powerups, and many are equipped with exclusive mechanics. Players also have the option to adjust the appearance of their vehicles using the in-game skin editor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7520U or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 610M or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: An arcade-style tank shooter. Players fight against each other in 10v10 PvP combat or play solo against enemies in a survival setting. A variety of unique vehicles and maps await - join the battle in this thrilling vehicular combat game!
